messages:
alex: FYI I've pushed PR #8423 for the onprem authz changes — needs a quick security scan and approval before the weekend cut. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/8423 :eyes:

maria: Looking now. Quick checklist: secrets in env, KMS calls, VPC egress changes, and any new third-party deps. Ping me if any of those are present.

jess: Thanks @maria. Short answers:
- No plaintext secrets in repo. Using Vault path -> `secret/data/onprem/authz`
- KMS: calls go through customer-HSM shim, config is gated behind feature flag `enable_hsm_shim`
- VPC: added an egress rule to 10.21.0.0/16 for the onprem service mesh; no public egress allowed.
- New deps: one small lib `jwt-utils@1.2.0` (MIT).

maria: Can you paste the snippet where the KMS client is instantiated? want to check TLS validation and endpoint override.

jess: Sure — snippet below:
```python
client = HSMClient(endpoint=os.environ.get('HSM_ENDPOINT'), tls_verify=True, key_id=os.environ['KMS_KEY_ID'])
client.set_retry_policy(backoff=Exponential(0.5, max=4))
```

maria: OK TLS verify is on, good. Two asks before LGTM:
1) Add explicit network policy in the Helm chart to deny all except the mesh CIDR (defense-in-depth).
2) Add a small e2e test that exercises the KMS failure path and asserts no secret is leaked to logs (can be simple pytest).

alex: We can add both in this branch. @jess how fast to add? we want to merge in the 10:00 deploy window tomorrow.

jess: I can push the Helm change + test by EOD PST today. Will add a quick `helm template` snippet to the PR.

security-bot: SAST scan completed — 1 low severity finding in `authz/validator.py` (unused import). No secret regex matches. Report: https://scans.redwood/reports/8423

sam: Small scheduling note: Please don't merge until the canary for private-dedicated was cleared (deploys team will run it at 10:30). If tests + my quick smoke pass, we can proceed at 11:00.

maria: Sounds good. After jess pushes, I'll do a quick review and flag any minor items. If the e2e exists and network policy is present, I'll approve. :thumbsup:

jess: Pushed fixes at 1769876570 (commit b7d9f3a). Helm policy added, pytest case added under `tests/e2e/test_kms_fail.py`.

maria: Reviewing commit b7d9f3a now. If CI passes, I'll mark approved. Also add a short note in PR description about the HSM shim and the VPC CIDR to help oncall later.

alex: Thanks everyone — looping in deploys on the schedule. cc @sam. :pray:

sam: Roger. I'll start the canary at 10:30 and post results here.
